body:
## Task

One file: `planner/planner-run.sh`. Uses `lib/tape.sh`.

When planner files a new backlog issue: `tape_proposal` with loop="dev", class=<label or "dev">, forecast=`{"p_success":0.5,"est_cost":0,"est_dvision":0}` (flat priors; calibration comes later), ref=<new issue number>.

That is the whole change. Tape failure warns and continues.

## Acceptance

Fixture: invoke the emit path with a fake issue number (TAPE_DIR override); one proposal line containing the forecast block lands in the tape. Verify with a bats test or shell fixture.


## Depends on

- #1405

## Status

2026-09-19 13:37–14:08 attempt: 22 turns of real work, no branch. llama-server aborted (CUDA error in mmproj/CLIP encode); dsh got 503 Loading model and exited rc 1. `no_push` was infra, not the spec. Worktree gone — start from scratch. Requeued to backlog.


## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When planner files a new backlog issue, a proposal record is emitted via `tape_proposal` with loop="dev", class=<label or "dev">, forecast `{"p_success":0.5,"est_cost":0,"est_dvision":0}`, ref=<new issue number>
- [ ] Tape failure warns and continues (planner run does not abort)
- [ ] A fixture/bats test invokes the emit path with a fake issue number (TAPE_DIR override) and verifies one proposal line containing the forecast block lands in the tape

## Affected files

- `planner/planner-run.sh` (emits the proposal record on backlog issue filing)
- `lib/tape.sh` (used via `tape_proposal`; expected unchanged)
